source: Authenticated Search Console UI, URL Inspection, and downloaded comparison workbooks
limitations: A last-crawl timestamp is not the date a page became unindexed.
The September 3 aggregate indexing report is older than the individual September 8 inspections.
Successful live availability and accepted indexing requests do not prove inclusion in Google's index.
The evidence does not identify one proven cause of the July decline or a manual penalty.
Query exports omit anonymized searches; do not sum them as site totals.
The Links report is a sample, not a complete backlink inventory.
temporaryRemovals: No requests submitted in the last 6 months

sitemap.note: Individual inspections sometimes say Temporary processing error for Sitemaps; the submitted sitemap report itself is successful.

crawlStats.hostStatus: No problems for tarahome.ai or www.tarahome.ai

aggregateIndexing.note: Noindex examples were slashless or HTTP variants, not the inspected trailing-slash canonical articles.

individualInspections.liveRendering: Updated title, full article, self-canonical, image, and TLDR verified in Google's HTML and smartphone screenshot

julyComparison.interpretation: Broad loss across established Home Assistant topics, with exceptions; not evidence that every Apple/Google topic failed.

latestComparison.note: Historical impressions in a 28-day window do not contradict a subsequent individual URL inspection showing not indexed.

homepageRendering.before: Two Google smartphone screenshots showed navigation and background without the hero copy; full page text was present in rendered HTML.
homepageRendering.localReproduction: At 412x12000 the uncapped bottom-aligned hero placed the H1 at y=11022.
homepageRendering.fix: Cap hero and inner grid minimum heights at 64rem and 56rem for all visitors, including the static fallback.
homepageRendering.googleAfter: Updated cap present in Google's tested HTML; smartphone screenshot visibly shows headline, hero image, buttons, kit summary and next section.
homepageRendering.indexStatusAfterFix: Not confirmed indexed; successful rendering and live eligibility are not indexing confirmation.
homepageRendering.causalLimit: The viewport defect is reproduced and repaired, but is not proven to explain the sitewide July traffic decline.
